Welcome

A little about me

Welcome on board — I'm Tom, Creative Director at Quantum.

I joined from Betway in May 2023, after previously being at Gamesys, and set out to build a Creative Studio that could scale with the business — the right structure, a stronger brand portfolio, and a faster, smarter way to deliver creative.

A lot has changed since. We're now 90+ people, we've rebranded the whole business and expanded beyond iGaming — with a big focus now on the rewards brands. And we're always looking to maximise our output, across a growing range of channels and markets.

Creative mission

We deliver high-quality creative at pace and scale — to power performance, elevate brands, and engage audiences across every channel, vertical and geo.

This is the studio: what we do, who we are, the projects in flight, and the work that shows it.

01
What we do

The Creative Studio helps the business communicate clearly, compete confidently and grow effectively. We combine creative thinking, brand, content and production to turn business needs into engaging, commercially relevant work.

Our role goes beyond making things look good. We shape brands, improve customer journeys, support campaigns and build scalable content that helps the business move faster. We also work as creative partners across the organisation, helping shape briefs, challenge thinking and find the strongest solution.

1

Quality creative at scale and pace

We make work that’s visually strong and commercially effective — good enough to stand alongside far bigger brands. Great creative is a leveller, so our ambition matches theirs.

Every brief runs the same play: research, concept, production, delivery. The depth flexes — hours or weeks — but the standard doesn’t. Most of it is made in-house, held to a consistently high bar whatever the volume or turnaround.

2

Multidisciplinary, end-to-end delivery

One studio, every discipline — design, motion, UI/UX, brand, copy, content, print and marketing comms.

So the work shifts fast: an AI-led UGC campaign for Cashback one day, a landing page, corporate deck or internal comms the next. We take it from first idea to final delivery, with strategy, message and execution joined up throughout.

3

Brand evolution and strategic identity

Brand is how the business shows up — from Quantum to every brand in the portfolio. And a brand is never finished: it has to evolve as audiences, markets and ambitions move.

We lead the creative behind new identities, verticals and brand systems, each with a clear point of view — building something new, or evolving what exists without losing what makes it recognisable. The Quantum rebrand is the proof: a more mature, flexible identity built to scale into new markets and channels.

4

Customer-first creative journeys

The customer sits at the centre of every decision. Before we worry about how it looks, we work out who we’re talking to, what moves them, and what might stop them.

That changes by audience and vertical — a seasoned iGaming player isn’t a first-time comparison user — so the approach adapts. We build an aligned journey across every touchpoint, from first ad to landing page, email and product, each step connected, intuitive and relevant.

5

Creative support across every channel

We support the business wherever creative moves the needle. Most of it drives commercial performance — partnering with Performance Marketing, CRM and Network on static, motion, email, UGC, banner farms and other revenue-driving content.

But we go beyond marketing too: landing pages, lead forms and UI with Product and Tech; guidelines, onboarding and comms for HR and the wider business; even the office walls. Wherever the business communicates, the studio has a role.

6

Powered by tools, process and AI

Scale comes from the tools and process behind the work. We’re one of the teams pushing AI adoption hardest — using it to do more, faster, without dropping quality. On a recent World Cup campaign, that meant a 95% cost saving versus the year before.

ChatGPT, Claude and Weavy are now core to the workflow; Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma anchor day-to-day design; Bannerflow scales production. Behind the scenes, Trello, PageProof, Zapier and the Creative Hub keep delivery tight, with Bynder as the home for finished work.

7

Always evolving

Stand still in creative and you fall behind. We’re always chasing what’s next — new tools, new formats and better ways to work.

The aim: make more of the everyday seamless, so the team spends its time where creative thinking matters most — concepts, new brands, new verticals, better experiences. More data-informed, more adaptive, more ambitious: a lean studio that delivers far beyond its size.

03
Projects

What’s in flight, and the challenges we’re solving. Three years in, the one thing I’ve learned is that priorities and projects shift fast — so we stay agile to the business goals and OKRs.

For FY26-27, the focus is clear: boost Rewards, build on our UK iGaming foundations, grow US social gaming, and embed AI across the whole business. No surprise, then, that our main projects right now line up behind exactly those goals.

In flight

Current focus

Rewards

Rewards is new to the business — we acquired Custard and Cashback from Subtech in July 2026. The task now is to audit where the brands sit, review their marketing output and level up across the board. A brand refresh is kicking off to sharpen both brands and everything they produce, alongside large-scale campaigns built to grow reach and volume.

Owner Tom
Collaborators Rich & Joe
Stakeholders Luke, Zara & Danny

AI, creative processes & platforms

Being AI-first is a top priority for the business, and the studio leads the way — building AI into our workflows, automations and everyday productivity. It’s an ongoing commitment: we keep investing in platforms that lift our output, with Weavy, Bannerflow and Bynder among the latest we’ve onboarded. We’re also unafraid to move on — Midjourney, for example, has left the toolkit for now.

Owner Rich & Tom
Collaborators the Creative team

Brand evolution

Brands never stand still — they evolve with consumer habits, shifting demographics and trends. So we keep evolving every brand in the portfolio, corporate and consumer alike. In 2025 that meant taking the corporate brand from QiH to Quantum; in 2026 we’re levelling up the Rewards brands, Custard and Cashback — all while maintaining our iGaming and wider portfolio.

Owner Rich & Joe
Collaborators Tom & the Creative team
Challenges

Where we're pushing next

Design by data

We're strengthening feedback loops with the business to better understand what creative succeeds and what doesn't. This insight-led approach pinpoints opportunities for commercial performance and builds a clear framework for continuous creative optimisation.

Marketing

Each team excels, but our messaging and customer journeys can lack cohesion. A dedicated coordination function would align efforts, unify strategy and keep every team working toward a consistent, impactful direction.

Planning

We often operate reactively when launching brands — recently two launched with minimal lead time. Clearer communication, earlier alignment and more structured decision-making across the business will make launches more efficient and more successful.
